Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 9-L at 5546-5548 W.
                              Belmont Ave - App No. 22082
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                        ORDINANCE


BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:


SECTION I . Title 17 ofthe Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all the current Bl-2 Neighborhood Shopping District symbols and
indications as shown on Map No. 9-L in the area bounded by:
              The public alley next north of and parallel to West Belmont Avenue; a line 150.00
              feet east of and parallel to North Central Avenue; West Belmont Avenue; and a line
              100.00 feet east of and parallel to North Central Avenue
to those of a CI -2, Neighborhood Commercial District.
SECTION 2. This Ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.


Address: 5546-48 West Belmont Avenue
                                          CITY OF CHICAGO
